group: C. TCRF "Regional Differences": what the Japanese side shows
item: Hot-spot: B pressed during a song keeps the music playing (JP only)
tcrf: The music keeps playing outside the hot-spot menu in JP
method: code diff of bank 3 + BGB on both ROMs (tools/bgb_hotspot_picker_b.py)
verdict: CONFIRMED (2026-10-19), code and BGB. In the hot-spot editor (mode $1A) the sound picker is state 05 (Mode1A_State05_PickSound 03:6C96); its values $20-$3F start a SONG through HotSpotEd_PreviewSound (03:75E9, list 03:7615). B in that state (03:6CD1-6CE7) stores the edit copy and calls HotSpotEd_PickerSlideOut. The two ROMs differ by one call: the international ROM enters the routine at 03:72F5 with push af / ld a,$FF / call Snd_Music (00:2B8A) / pop af / rst $08 (the mailbox $DD68 = $FF = reset the music, then one frame), the JP routine (03:72F9) starts at the sfx $12 and never touches the music mailbox; the international bank 3 has exactly one more Snd_Music call than the JP one (11 against 10); the routine is also called from the confirm state 08 (03:6DE6), so A there stops the music in the international ROM too. BGB, same key path from corpus entry 1042 (state 1A:05), Down twice (songs $2B, $3F, $42, $40 requested), then B: JP writes no $DD68 after the B (only sfx $12), $DD69 (playing song) = $40 400 frames later, the same as the control run without B; international writes $FF from 00:2B8A at the B, $DD69 = 0. Side note: the picker's list differs at value $2E (JP: song $1E, the alias of the title music; international: song $2D). Nobody listened.
